classification.difficultyReason: Explain a misconception about adding successive percentage increases using the changing base.

content.prompt:
Zach's rent increased by 10% in 2019 and by 15% in 2020.
Zach says that his rent has increased by 25% in these two years. Explain why he is incorrect.

answer.short: The 15% applies to the increased rent. $1.1\times1.15=1.265$, so the overall increase is 26.5%.
answer.worked:
The 2020 increase applies to the rent after the 2019 increase, so the multipliers must be multiplied.
$$\begin{align*}\text{Combined multiplier}&=1.1\times1.15\\&=1.265\\\text{Overall increase}&=126.5\%-100\%\\&=26.5\%\end{align*}$$
